title: phegopteris brevipes
intro: Phegopteris brevipes, commonly known as the Japanese chain fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris brevipes include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antibacterial activity, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
